name: CubeField
description: Represents a hierarchy or measure field from an OLAP cube. In a PivotTable report, the CubeField object is a member of the CubeFields collection.
example:
Set objNewSheet = Worksheets.Add
objNewSheet.Activate
intRow = 1
For Each objPF in _
 Worksheets("Sheet1").PivotTables(1).PivotFields
 If objPF.CubeField.CubeFieldType = xlHierarchy Then
 objNewSheet.Cells(intRow, 1).Value = objPF.Name
 intRow = intRow + 1
 End If
Next objPF

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: CubeFieldType
properties.description: Indicates whether the OLAP cube field is a hierarchy field or a measure field. Can be one of the XlCubeFieldType constants.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the specified field.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlPivotFieldOrientation value that represents the location of the field in the specified PivotTable report.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the position of the hierarchy field on the PivotTable report when it's dragged from the field well.

properties.name: TreeviewControl
properties.description: Returns the TreeviewControl object of the CubeField object, representing the cube manipulation control of an OLAP-based PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: DragToColumn
properties.description: True if the specified field can be dragged to the column position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToHide
properties.description: True if the field can be hidden by being dragged off the PivotTable report. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToPage
properties.description: True if the field can be dragged to the page position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToRow
properties.description: True if the field can be dragged to the row position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToData
properties.description: True if the specified field can be dragged to the data position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasMemberProperties
properties.description: Returns True when there are member properties specified to be displayed for the cube field. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: LayoutForm
properties.description: Returns or sets the way the specified PivotTable items appear-in table format or in outline format. Read/write XlLayoutFormType.

properties.name: PivotFields
properties.description: Returns the PivotFields collection. This collection contains all PivotTable fields, including those that aren't currently visible on-screen. Read-only PivotFields object.

properties.name: EnableMultiplePageItems
properties.description: Set to True to allow multiple items in the page field area for OLAP PivotTables to be selected. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LayoutSubtotalLocation
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the PivotTable field subtotals in relation to (either above or below) the specified field. Read/write XlSubtotalLocationType.

properties.name: ShowInFieldList
properties.description: When set to True (default), a CubeField object will be shown in the field list. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludeNewItemsInFilter
properties.description: The IncludeNewItemsInFilter property is used to track included/excluded items in OLAP PivotTables. Read/write.

properties.name: CubeFieldSubType
properties.description: Specifies the type of a CubeField. Read-only.

properties.name: AllItemsVisible
properties.description: The AllItemsVisible property checks whether manual filtering is applied to a PivotField or CubeField. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: CurrentPageName
properties.description: Returns or sets the page name for a CubeField. Read/write String.

properties.name: IsDate
properties.description: Returns True if the CubeField is a date. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the label text for the cube field.

properties.name: FlattenHierarchies
properties.description: Returns or sets whether items from all levels of hierarchies in a named set cube field are displayed in the same field of a PivotTable report based on an OLAP cube. Read/write.

properties.name: HierarchizeDistinct
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to order and remove duplicates when displaying the specified named set in a PivotTable report based on an OLAP cube. Read/write.

methods.name: AddMemberPropertyField
methods.signature: AddMemberPropertyField(Property As String, [PropertyOrder As Variant], [PropertyDisplayedIn As Variant])
methods.description: Adds a member property field to the display for the cube field.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: The unique name of the member property. For balanced hierarchies, a unique name can be created by appending the "quoted" member property name to the unique name of the level with which the member property is associated. For unbalanced hierarchies, a unique name can be created by appending the "quoted" member property name to the unique name of the hierarchy.

parameters.name: PropertyOrder
parameters.description: Sets the PropertyOrder property value for a CubeField object. The actual position in the collection will be immediately before the PivotTable field that currently has the same PropertyOrder value that is given in the argument. If no field has the given PropertyOrder value, the range of acceptable values is 1 to the number of member properties already showing for the hierarchy plus one. This argument is one-based. If omitted, the property goes to the end of the list.

parameters.name: PropertyDisplayedIn
parameters.description: Specifies where to display the property. If this argument is omitted, the member property field will be added to the PivotTable only.

methods.name: ClearManualFilter
methods.description: The ClearManualFilter method provides an easy way to set the Visible property to True for all items of a PivotField in PivotTables, and to empty the HiddenItemsList/VisibleItemsList collections in OLAP PivotTables.

methods.name: CreatePivotFields
methods.description: The CreatePivotFields method enables users to apply a filter to PivotFields not yet added to the PivotTable by creating the corresponding PivotField object.

methods.name: AutoGroup
methods.description: Automatically groups the cube fields in an OLAP cube, optionally in the specified orientation and/or at the specified position.
